title: Wood 1996: csa anatomical of psoas major at L4-L5 (M, unspecified)

imaging.plane: transverse image at the L4-L5 level (scanner axial)

quantity.name: csa_anatomical
quantity.definition: anatomical cross-sectional area of the muscle in the image plane (as cut, not corrected for fibre direction)

source.authors: Wood S, Pearsall DJ, Ross R, Reid JG
source.sample: 26 males; males with BMI 19.7-39.5 (lean to obese)

how_to_simulate: Select all psoas major fascicles whose path crosses the plane at L4-L5 (transverse image at the L4-L5 level (scanner axial)), one side.
Sum their PCSA; divide each PCSA by cos(angle between fascicle and plane normal) to get anatomical CSA.
Compare the one-side total with the measured mean +/- SD (bilateral sums are labelled side=bilateral_sum).
protocol.notes: Trunk CSA (all) 677.6 (188.5) cm2. Muscle CSA as % trunk CSA also tabulated (not stored).

data.note: side not stated; magnitudes match one-side values of other studies

extraction.check_notes: All values read from the rendered (rotated) Table 1 on p.142; text layer had OCR errors (e.g. BMI 25-30 mass printed 93.5 in text layer, 83.5 on the page).
